blockers.title: VectorIndexManager destructor not marked noexcept
blockers.description: Destructor calls shutdown() which is not noexcept and can throw exceptions, violating C++11 contract and causing std::terminate() at program exit.
blockers.root_cause: shutdown() performs I/O operations (saveIndex, filesystem writes) that can throw; destructor has no exception wrapper

impact.user_facing: Service crash at shutdown/restart if exception occurs during index save
impact.technical: std::terminate() called if exception propagates from destructor

blockers.title: Unsafe raw delete operations without exception safety
blockers.description: Raw delete followed by nullptr assignment without exception wrapping; if delete throws before nullptr assignment, dangling pointer remains.
blockers.root_cause: Sequential delete + nullptr without try-catch; violates RAII pattern and creates use-after-free vulnerability

impact.user_facing: Heap corruption, segmentation fault on subsequent access to deleted memory
impact.technical: Use-after-free, potential double-delete if exception path triggered

blockers.title: GPUVectorIndex default destructor calls potentially-throwing shutdown()
blockers.description: Default destructor (= default) calls pImpl which calls shutdown() that is not noexcept; violates noexcept contract.
blockers.root_cause: Destructor delegated to pImpl which performs non-noexcept operations without exception handling

impact.user_facing: GPU vector index destruction crashes if exception occurs during GPU memory cleanup
impact.technical: std::terminate() called; potential GPU memory resource leak if cleanup partially completes

blockers.title: Iterator invalidation in rebuildOversubPartitions() due to concurrent modifications
blockers.description: vectorData.size() cached once before loop; if vectorData resizes during iteration (concurrent add/remove), indices become invalid causing out-of-bounds access.
blockers.root_cause: No synchronization between partition rebuild and vectorData mutations; size not re-checked in loop

impact.user_facing: Segmentation fault during index rebuild if concurrent add/remove operations occur
impact.technical: Out-of-bounds vector access, reading/writing beyond allocated memory
impact.probability: MEDIUM (concurrent GPU operations likely trigger this)

blockers.title: Missing focused test files for destructor and iterator safety validation
blockers.description: 0 of 5 required test files exist: test_index_destructor_safety.cpp, test_index_iterator_validity.cpp, test_index_gpu_memory_safety.cpp, test_index_lock_ordering.cpp, test_index_connection_lifecycle.cpp. Phase 5 checklist requires ≥10 focused test cases per batch.
blockers.root_cause: Test files not created; existing test suite (26 files) does not cover CRITICAL/HIGH gap fix validation

impact.user_facing: Cannot verify correctness of gap fixes; CRITICAL issues not validated before merge
impact.technical: ASan/TSan cannot run on destructor/iterator code paths; no CI/CD gate verification possible

blockers.title: CMake build presets develop-strict, develop-asan, develop-tsan not defined
blockers.description: Phase 5 CI/CD gates reference develop-strict, develop-asan, develop-tsan presets in CMakePresets.json, but only community-asan, community-ubsan, linux-asan, linux-ubsan variants exist. CI/CD gates cannot execute with incorrect preset names.
blockers.root_cause: Preset naming convention does not match Phase 5 plan expectations; missing develop-* variants required for CI/CD

impact.user_facing: Cannot execute CI/CD validation gates for CP-1; blockers all 4 checkpoints
impact.technical: cmake --preset develop-asan fails; all sanitizer testing requires preset exists

summary.cp1_blocked_reason: 6 critical/high/medium findings block CP-1 sign-off; all must be resolved before CI/CD gates can execute

tracking.escalation_threshold: Any CRITICAL finding unresolved after 2 business days
